[h1]Review[/h1] 
I played the game during release, mostly because you can play it in coop and its free. I didn’t expect much and my enjoyment lasted much less than the main story was over.

[u]Gameplay[/u]
You can carry three weapons that have their own ammo pool, big guns weapons being so rare to get it basically useful only to burst down special enemies or bosses. Of course, some types are unbalanced and mostly you will be trying to aim for a special named weapon, trying to farm same missions to craft that item. Crafting multiple of them will make you able to upgrade that weapon.
Mostly you will need all of this solely for boss fights or higher difficulties. Or both. The boss fights in an arena type cyber world are awesome, but rather unbalanced. You mostly loose because you can’t get an DPS check or have the wrong descendant. Some descendends are more useful against special bosses due to their abilities weapon type, some are less useful in general as their ability cannot help you damage the boss. The game is a bit more balanced during the coop horde mode, which takes incredibly long time to take up the pace to be actually challenging, making it solely a time waste until you realize yourself suck or are underleveled or your teammates. Not to mention the superior version of your character, called an ultimate requires tons of grinding and low drop chances in the 1-5% range. Normal characters already require a lot of grinding, yet its doable within a couple of hours depending on luck.

Missions are mostly random mini missions which require you to defend an area, take out enemies, hit switches and wait, with sometimes having more interesting stuff like parkour which works incredibly well due to neat movement of the game with grappling hooks and various character abilities. Also, you have raids that offer a more engaging dungeon like story mission that ends usually in a boss fight. Grinding is later required too. Not to mention that there is no reason, or when I played, to play any other character while grinding, aside maybe bosses, than bunny due to the characters high passive damage and movement speed. It makes other characters damage, speed and flexibility laughable.
The way the upgrading system works is neat, as it gives a lot of flexibility without seeming to complex with its upgrade chips that improve many aspects you want to focus on, like specific elemental type damage, ultimate charge speed and so on.

[u]Story[/u]
Not noteworthy, mostly nothing of interest is explained while the mentioned first descendant is never in any way mentioned in this game.

[u]Sound[/u]
Bad voiceacting, repetitive and annoying sound effects, music that i did not notice and guns that dont really sound punchy.

[u]Graphics[/u]
Game looks decent, not good, just works for what it wants to do. Open areas with lots of players walking around. Areas vary in setting but leave little interest to explore aside for grinding a specific chest type item.

[u]Conclusion/TL;DR[/u]
The first descendant is one of the most forgettable coop shooter experiences I had. Classes seem interesting but are hardly useful to pick aside 1-2. After finishing the main story all that is left is grinding out items, with little to impossible challenge depending on your build. If you like this type of games, it can have some merit as everything can be unlocked for free with enough grinding and its a free to play game. Otherwise, i dont see much reason to recommend this game to anyone.
